items.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
items.description: Posterior Matching Distillation trains a stochastic student to match a teacher diffusion model’s full posterior via tilted mean constraints, enabling high-quality few-step image generation without auxiliary score networks.

items.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.description: A fixed set of steering vectors added to a frozen diffusion transformer recovers most of the quality gains from reinforcement learning post-training, indicating that much of the improvement comes from a constant shift rather than prompt-specific transformations.
items.ai_summary: Research paper proposing a fixed set of steering vectors to approximate reinforcement learning post-training in diffusion transformers without input-dependent transformations.

items.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming

items.ai_summary: Research paper presenting TideCache, a hybrid language model serving system that improves latency and agent turns through transparent cache management and layer-wise streaming.

items.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
items.description: O2LaF repurposes a shared pretrained video model to learn inverse and forward latent action dynamics from unlabeled videos, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot action probing and zero-shot action transfer.
items.ai_summary: Research paper introducing O2LaF, a framework that repurposes pretrained video generators into inverse and forward dynamics models for self-supervised latent action learning.

items.title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
items.description: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs.
items.ai_summary: Research paper introducing ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone.

items.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
items.description: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives.
items.ai_summary: Research paper presenting AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework and dataset for action-level analysis of frontier models in direct robot control.

items.ai_summary: Research paper presenting variants of beam search and a beam predictor to reduce query latency in disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search graphs.

items.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.description: A single scalable network estimates dense metric depth for images and video at native resolution, jointly improving metric accuracy, boundary sharpness, and temporal consistency.

items.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
items.description: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed.
items.ai_summary: Research paper establishing an evaluation framework and systematizing published evidence on the evolving capability of large language models in software vulnerability research.

items.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
items.description: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget.
items.ai_summary: Research paper proposing OracleImitator, an active feature acquisition method that uses soft-target imitation to distill an explicit oracle teacher into a deployable policy.

items.title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.description: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model.
items.ai_summary: Research paper presenting Physically Grounded Execution, a framework that decomposes long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation into state machine control, VLA skills, and spatial consistency components.

items.description: A task-adaptive agentic framework utilizes 3D proxies, physics simulation, and multi-agent coordination to enhance the structural control, physical plausibility, and visual realism of generated videos.

items.title: Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning
items.description: Self-consistency certification treats repeated sampling from a language model as sequential evidence accumulation and stops when an anytime-valid e-process crosses a threshold, guaranteeing finite-sample Type I error control by Ville's inequality.
items.ai_summary: Self-consistency certification framework that accounts for correlated reasoning streams to guarantee proper finite-sample error control when evaluating language models.

items.title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images

items.description: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is at the center of modern machine learning and is known to be statistically minimax-optimal in many regression settings, e.g., for convex Generalized Linear Models (GLMs).

items.description: Commercial video-generation APIs bill by model and tier, while intermediaries could substitute cheaper models, lower tiers, or cached clips. What can a delivered file establish about its origin?
items.ai_summary: A graded audit combines passive attribution and cryptographic provenance to evaluate commercial video-generation APIs and verify tier and model claims.

items.title: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Continual reinforcement learning requires agents to adapt when the task changes while reusing what they know about the environment. Successor features separate dynamics from task-specific reward, but their effectiveness depends on the choice of base features.
items.ai_summary: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features builds a reusable basis from eigenvectors of a transition matrix to enable efficient continual reinforcement learning without replay buffers.

items.title: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
items.description: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely.
items.ai_summary: SGAR is a sparse geometry-guided attention method for feed-fast 3D reconstruction that replaces dense global attention with efficient cross-view proximity token selection.

items.title: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
items.description: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review.
items.ai_summary: Rad-Linter is a fine-tuned language model that reads chest X-ray image evidence scores to accurately detect potential errors and inconsistencies in radiology reports.

items.title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
items.description: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent.
items.ai_summary: FLUID is a unified framework for situated task guidance that evaluates and enables flexible, evidence-grounded human-AI interactions with appropriate timing.

items.title: SHUSH: Emission-Aware Reward Design for Proactive Video Assistants
items.description: Proactive video assistants must decide not only what to say, but also when to speak. Existing reinforcement-learning objectives can reward timely, correct responses without accounting for response volume, thereby encouraging unnecessary or repeated emissions.
items.ai_summary: SHUSH introduces an emission-aware F1 reward for proactive video assistants to prevent over-emission and improve response timing and content accuracy.

items.title: Anticipating Future Build Results with BuildPredictor
items.description: Continuous Integration (CI) is a popular programming practice for the seamless integration of code changes into the code base. Using CI, developers benefit from automated assembling and testing of the code after each commit.
items.ai_summary: BuildPredictor is a random forest model that anticipates continuous integration build outcomes using source, complexity, and historical features to save computational resources.

items.title: A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes
items.description: We present a new adaptive stepsize rule that biases gradient descent toward flatter minima in both theory and practice, and establish the first uniform-in-time guarantees for both sharpness and loss reduction for a broad class of locally quadratic objectives.
items.ai_summary: Critically damped Polyak stepsizes introduce an adaptive stepsize rule for gradient descent that biases optimization toward flatter minima and reduces sharpness.

items.title: Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces
items.description: Set pieces produce about a third of non-penalty expected goals (xG), yet they are usually evaluated by what happened next.
items.ai_summary: Monte Carlo Pass Search is a simulation-based method for evaluating and optimizing soccer set pieces using 3D ball physics and generative player models.

items.title: Neural Conditional Gaussian Model: Efficient Data Assimilation with Sequential Uncertainty Quantification for Nonlinear Dynamics
items.description: Data assimilation (DA) in partially observed nonlinear systems requires repeated estimation of both hidden states and their uncertainty. Conventional nonlinear filtering can be computationally expensive and often relies on an explicit dynamical model.
items.ai_summary: Neural Conditional Gaussian Model is a data-driven dynamical model that uses a learned latent space with conditional Gaussian structures for efficient data assimilation and uncertainty quantification.

items.title: Bayesian optimization on amortized search space
items.description: In real-world black-box optimization problems, a mechanistic simulator is often available that approximately predicts the behavior of the system as a function of the parameters being optimized.
items.ai_summary: Bayesian optimization on amortized search space uses an amortized inverse map of a mechanistic simulator to restrict the search space and improve optimization efficiency in real-world problems.

items.title: Fixing the Last Mile: Failure-Aware Image Restoration with Region-Specific Guidance
items.description: Recent advances in image restoration have greatly improved global image fidelity, producing visually plausible results across most regions of an image.
items.ai_summary: Failure-Aware Image Restoration is a region-bound conditioning approach that addresses localized failures in image restoration by applying targeted corrective guidance to specific areas.

items.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
items.description: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters.
items.ai_summary: Zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives compile deterministic computation circuits directly into pretrained language model weights without altering natural-language competence or requiring training examples.

items.title: Scaling classical hardware for accurate real-time quantum error correction
items.description: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires a classical decoder fast enough to process syndrome measurements at the rate at which they are generated, and to return its decisions with low latency.
items.ai_summary: Rapids is a streaming neural decoder co-designed with an FPGA to process quantum error correction syndrome measurements with low latency and high accuracy.

items.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
items.description: A diagnostic benchmark of 180 simulated manipulation configurations evaluates whether embodied systems can combine history-based reasoning, precise execution, and closed-loop environmental feedback, revealing that single-view competence does not transfer to composed tasks.

items.title: Should Belgians Install an Advanced Energy Management System in Their Electrified Dwelling ?
items.description: As dwellings electrify and more complex electricity pricing spreads in Belgium, the question arises: What are the potential benefits of installing an advanced energy management systems in an electrified Belgian dwelling ?
items.ai_summary: Study on advanced energy management systems in Belgian dwellings evaluates model predictive control and machine learning strategies to optimize electrified heating and vehicle charging costs.

items.title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
items.description: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert.
items.ai_summary: Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer is a framework that models temporal shifts in human expert reliability using a sequence model to improve human-AI task allocation over time.

items.title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.description: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters.
items.ai_summary: R2-VLA is a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented framework that uses uncertainty prediction to manage test-time adaptation and expert assistance in vision-language-action models.

items.title: Asuka-FM: A System-Architectural Co-Design Framework for Efficient Text-to-Image Pretraining on Consumer Hardware
items.description: Frontier text-to-image (T2I) foundation models predominantly rely on multi-billion parameter Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pretrained across massive compute clusters, creating an accessibility barrier for academic laboratories.
items.ai_summary: Asuka-FM is a system and architectural co-design framework that enables efficient pretraining of text-to-image diffusion transformers from scratch on a single consumer GPU.

items.title: HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
items.description: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable.
items.ai_summary: HumanCOIN is a 12,500-hour first-person manipulation dataset featuring gaze, exertion, and cognition proxies to study human intent in physical tasks.

items.title: AdaPixFlow: Learning Continuous-Time 3D Dynamics Across Scenes from Sparse Multi-view Observations
items.description: Understanding how objects move in dynamic scenes requires recovering their 3D motion from visual observations and predicting their positions at unobserved times.
items.ai_summary: AdaPixFlow is a learning method that uses multi-view RGB-D observations to predict continuous-time 3D object motion across different scenes without per-scene optimization.

items.title: FFGaussType: Feed-Forward Conversion of Glyph and SVG Geometry into Compact Gaussian Assets
items.description: Immersive 3D content allows text and graphical elements, such as subtitles, annotations, and icons, to be placed inside a scene rather than displayed as flat overlays.
items.ai_summary: FFGaussType is a feed-forward model that converts glyph and SVG outlines into compact neural Gaussian assets in a single forward pass for 3D graphics.

items.title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
items.description: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation.
items.ai_summary: MemFolder is a memory management framework that uses record structure and context folding to reduce record counts and context lengths for long-term AI agents.

items.title: Exact Bayesian layers via characteristic functions
items.description: Bayesian neural networks provide principled uncertainty estimates, but training them with Monte Carlo sampling can be expensive.
items.ai_summary: CF-Prop is an uncertainty propagation method using characteristic functions to compute exact output distributions for Bayesian ReLU layers without sampling.

items.title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
items.description: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal.
items.ai_summary: Seer is an inference-time framework that uses offline-trained simulators and value estimators to guide small on-device deep-research agents without extra tool calls.

items.title: Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) can generate Q-matrices for diagnostic classification models that approximate expert specifications, but evaluations have focused on the final matrices, leaving the basis of individual item-attribute assignments unexamined.
items.ai_summary: Reasoning-Trace Analysis uses large language models and chain-of-thought prompting to generate, compare, and inspect attribute-labeled reasoning steps for Q-matrix construction.

items.title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
items.description: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale.
items.ai_summary: Awaken-HI is a vision-language-action model trained on paired egocentric video and whole-body human motion data to improve humanoid loco-manipulation tasks.

items.title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
items.description: Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure.
items.ai_summary: This composite World Model integrates a spiking neural network memory block with transformer blocks to efficiently model material defects and structural variations in real time.

items.title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
items.description: ZeroVLN is a slow-fast vision-language navigation framework that avoids navigation-domain supervised fine-tuning of the VLM brain by using a semantic tool-calling interface and closed-loop reinforcement learning to coordinate a language-based brain with an action expert,…

items.title: Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
items.description: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN), improve language model outputs by generating multiple candidates per prompt and selecting among them using a reward model.
items.ai_summary: e-RWSC is an anytime-valid stopping method using betting supermartingales to efficiently halt generation during inference-time model alignment while bounding error probabilities.

items.title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
items.description: The transition from fossil fuels presents significant challenges in energy management.
items.ai_summary: The TreeC machine learning method learns understandable and efficient residential energy management strategies that perform competitively with model predictive control and reinforcement learning.

items.title: Statistical Inference with Ill-Conditioned Random Weight Neural Network Sieves
items.description: Random weight neural networks (RWNNs) are shallow networks whose hidden-layer parameters are randomly generated and then kept fixed, while only the output coefficients are estimated.
items.ai_summary: A theoretical analysis of random weight neural network sieves reveals that their covariance matrix eigenvalues diminish as dimension grows, and establishes new approximation, estimation, and inference guarantees.

items.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
items.description: WeMM-Video is a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models that unify text, image, audio, and video processing for joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, using hybrid thinking modes and large-scale training to achieve strong open-source video…

items.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
items.description: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks.
items.ai_summary: Edit-Ready Training prepares vision models for direct weight-space programming by large language models, significantly increasing editing success rates across various vision tasks.

items.title: Chrome AI features wasting much bandwidth
items.description: Trending on Hacker News from perishablepress.com. 128 points and 49 comments.
items.ai_summary: Chrome AI features running by default can consume significant bandwidth and data usage over time if left enabled.

items.title: Flow Matching from Non-Gaussian Sources: A Theory of Efficient Sampling
items.description: Flow matching is a versatile framework for generative modeling that transports a source distribution to a target data distribution. A key advantage is its flexibility in the choice of source distribution, such as heavy-tailed and multimodal sources.
items.ai_summary: A nonasymptotic convergence theory for Euler-discretized flow matching with non-Gaussian source distributions establishes finite-step sampling guarantees and total variation error bounds.

items.title: TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
items.description: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation.
items.ai_summary: TacInno isolates contact dynamics that cannot be explained by vision and actions alone, using this tactile innovation as a training target to improve visuo-lateral-action model manipulation success rates.

items.title: Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
items.description: EU-funded projects produce extensive evidence in the form of deliverables, reports, and case studies. However, this knowledge is typically scattered across projects and document structures, making it difficult to locate relevant, contextual information when making decisions.
items.ai_summary: An Agentic AI Ecosystem combines heterogeneous water governance project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and uses an adaptive retrieval-augmented generation pipeline to improve information retrieval.

items.title: AI isn't replacing your job. It's turning it into low-paid gig work
items.description: Trending on Hacker News from restofworld.org. 133 points and 66 comments.

items.title: Simulation-pretrained autoencoders versus PCA for compressing multimode fibre transmission matrices
items.description: Multimode optical fibres can image through a thin, flexible probe once their transmission matrix (TM) has been measured, but a TM is large and must be re-measured whenever the fibre moves.
items.ai_summary: A simulation-pretrained autoencoder compresses multimode fibre transmission matrices and provides a reliable prior when few or no real transmission matrix measurements exist.

items.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
items.description: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods.
items.ai_summary: ViDecide trains video diffusion models as decision-centric reasoners and planners that predict state transitions causally and use corrective fine-tuning to achieve high success rates on planning tasks.

items.title: GateTrace: Where Do Crowd Crossings Go Missing Under Occlusion?
items.description: At large events, pedestrian tracking supports entrance and passageway counts, but totals hide which crossings were missed. In a stadium study, the system recorded about four in five clearly visible crossings but fewer than one in three mostly obscured crossings.
items.ai_summary: GateTrace derives reference crossings from pedestrian annotations and traces missed crowd crossings under occlusion to help evaluate pedestrian tracking systems.

items.title: SEEC: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Self-Supervised External-Eye Representation Learning
items.description: External-eye photography captures clinically relevant periocular anatomy at low acquisition cost, yet no large-scale standardized resource exists for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representations.
items.ai_summary: The Standardized External-Eye Corpus provides a 4.35-million-image dataset and benchmark for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representation learning across anatomical and clinical tasks.

items.title: A Complete Geometric Message-Passing Architecture for Point Clouds
items.description: Three-dimensional point clouds are a fundamental data modality, and a large family of machine learning architectures has been developed to respect their natural symmetries to rigid motions and permutations.
items.ai_summary: Geometric message-passing architecture for point clouds that uses a novel equivariant design to achieve completeness without high-order representations or intensive tests.

items.title: Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
items.description: We present an internal, pre-registered evaluation of the UCMT causal discovery algorithm family alongside established alternatives across heterogeneous benchmark regimes, complemented by a separately pre-registered, controlled study of UCMT v2 Global components.
items.ai_summary: Causal discovery algorithm family that compares configurations across benchmarks, showing specific improvements in directed F1 scores over established methods.

items.title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
items.description: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion.

items.title: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
items.description: Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing.
items.ai_summary: Comparative evaluation of thirteen drug-target interaction systems showing that model predictions often lack consensus and vary in hit enrichment reliability.

items.title: Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
items.description: Low-dose and thin-slice computed tomography (CT) images suffer from elevated noise that obscures anatomical detail, while clean references for supervised denoising are often unavailable.
items.ai_summary: Self-supervised generative CT denoising method that accelerates few-step sampling via improved mean flow to effectively suppress noise and preserve anatomical detail.

items.title: Launch HN: Onlook (YC W25) – An open-source developer tool for designers
items.description: Hey HN, I'm Daniel, founder of Onlook ( https://github.com/onlook-dev/onlook and onlook.com). Onlook is a desktop app that puts a canvas on top of your real codebase, letting you design directly in code with the agent you already use.
items.ai_summary: Onlook is an open-source desktop application that places a visual canvas over a codebase to let designers build and edit code using AI agents.

items.title: Contactless Estimation of Respiratory Frequency Using 3D-CNN on Thermal Images
items.description: Monitoring physiological parameters such as respiratory rate ($f_R$) is essential for diagnosing and managing various pathological conditions.
items.ai_summary: Deep learning method using a 3D convolutional neural network on thermal videos to estimate respiratory frequency without complex pre-processing or region-of-tracking.

items.title: World Models Favor Learned Priors over Visual Evidence
items.description: World models are increasingly used to simulate physical interactions, but training a separate model for each environment limits scalability. Cross-environment prediction requires identifying the current physical rule, which appearance alone may not reveal.
items.ai_summary: Benchmark and rule inference method for evaluating and mitigating how world models incorrectly favor common physical rules over rare ones during cross-environment transfer.

items.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
items.description: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective.
items.ai_summary: Hidden sparse attention method for large language models that computes partial dot products along the hidden dimension to improve inference speed and memory footprint.

items.title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
items.description: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history.
items.ai_summary: Open-source pipeline and deployment method that extracts short lessons from agent execution trajectories to generate guidelines for improving long-horizon task completion.

items.title: Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
items.description: Continuous diffusion models generate discrete data through stochastic dynamics in an embedding space. We consider jump diffusions that additionally reset coordinates to embeddings of categorical values.
items.ai_summary: Jump diffusion model variant using leave-one-out prediction that improves text and molecular graph generation metrics by predicting coordinates from other corrupted states.

items.title: Beam Model Technical Report
items.description: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.
items.ai_summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts model optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads while requiring significantly less inference compute than comparable models.

items.title: Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields
items.description: Interpolating a spatial field, such as daily maximum temperature, from sparse, irregularly located observations recurs across the environmental and health sciences. Standard Gaussian-process kriging refits hyperparameters and solves an $O(N^3)$ system for every new field.
items.ai_summary: MambaFlowNP is a linear-time joint-predictive neural process trained with conditional flow matching that interpolates irregularly observed spatial fields efficiently.

items.title: TRCF: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
items.description: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting supports healthcare monitoring, environmental analysis, and activity recognition. Channel-independent (CI) approaches capture each variable's temporal patterns but do not explicitly use observations from other variables.
items.ai_summary: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting is a framework that combines a channel-independent forecaster with a complementary channel-dependent branch to predict irregular multivariate time series.

items.title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
items.description: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models.
items.ai_summary: Perfumer is a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with predictive models to accelerate structural relaxation and electronic band predictions.

items.title: OffBeat: Multicoset Sampling for 4D Capture Beyond the Camera Frame Rate
items.description: For 4D reconstruction, a synchronized multi-camera rig records all views at the same timestamps and misses the motion between them. Staggered triggers spread the same frames over more timestamps.
items.ai_summary: OffBeat is a multicoset sampling method that models staggered camera rigs to achieve high-quality 4D capture and reconstruction beyond the camera frame rate.

items.title: Context as a Resource
items.description: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface.
items.ai_summary: ClonAct is a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks using a pluggable context memory management unit and synaptic bus to manage concurrent multi-stream tasks efficiently.

items.title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
items.description: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge.
items.ai_summary: DeepQuest is an AI scientist framework that transforms literature reviews into testable hypotheses and generates traceable research findings for Alzheimer's disease.

items.title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
items.description: Large language models increasingly rely on extended reasoning traces, yet the training signals used to shape this behavior remain coarse.
items.ai_summary: Edit-based training is a method that improves large language model reasoning instruction-following by supervising the model exclusively on localized textual corrections of its failures.

items.title: Sirius-Tiamat: How Small Can a One-Pass Decision Encoder Get Before Its Decisions Change?
items.description: A one-pass decision encoder reads a text, a question and several named options, and returns a probability for each option in a single forward pass. We ask how far Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder of this kind, can be compressed before its decisions change.
items.ai_summary: Analysis of the Laya decision encoder reveals how model compression techniques like rounding, pruning, and quantization alter its classification decisions and calibration.

items.title: One Framework to Diagnose Them All: A Stratified Benchmark for Bengali LLM Hallucination
items.description: Hallucination research in low-resource languages fragments easily: each newly named failure mode prompts its own dataset, spending scarce annotators on incomparable resources. We argue for consolidation and test it at community scale.
items.ai_summary: Alikbachan is a stratified Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark and dataset that evaluates zero-shot language model judges and competition systems across multiple failure modes.

items.title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
items.description: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) often answer questions from incomplete records. Missing information might be interpreted as unknown or false, depending on the completeness of the source.
items.ai_summary: ClosureBench is a benchmark that evaluates whether large language models correctly handle missing information under different closure assumptions.

items.title: Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
items.description: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation.
items.ai_summary: Temporal Rotation Quantization is a 2-bit KV-cache quantization method for video diffusion transformers that fits orthogonal transforms online to reduce quantization error and improve subject consistency in long video generation.

items.title: OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
items.description: Numerical simulation is important in ocean engineering, but model construction requires expert knowledge.
items.ai_summary: OceanCoder is a verification-guided large language model that uses a three-layer verification framework and graded rewards to automate simulation modelling and code generation for ocean engineering tasks.

items.title: Rigel-Ladon: An Option-Count Law for a One-Pass Decision Encoder, Tested on Held-Out Option Counts and Held-Out Schemas
items.description: Laya is a small neural network that reads a text, a question and K written options, and returns one probability per option in a single pass. We ask how its accuracy falls as K grows from 2 to 35 and whether that can be predicted.
items.ai_summary: Study on the accuracy of a single-pass decision encoder reveals a log-linear relationship between logit accuracy and the number of available options as choice sets grow.

items.title: Conformal Selection for Hierarchical Streaming Data
items.description: Many real-world tasks involve making sequential decisions about whether to select candidates before their responses of interest are revealed.
items.ai_summary: Online Hierarchical Selection is a distribution-free method that constructs rank-based e-values for hierarchical data streams to perform online candidate selection while controlling the false discovery rate.

items.title: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
items.description: Predicting part distortion before fabrication remains challenging in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), while thermomechanical simulation is computationally expensive for repeated design evaluations.
items.ai_summary: Two-branch graph attention network predicts three-dimensional surface displacement and manufacturing distortion from STL-derived meshes and part-level descriptors for laser powder bed fusion parts.

items.title: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
items.description: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons.
items.ai_summary: FirstCross is a network-free 3D reconstruction approach that solves convex problems on a voxel grid using first-crossing photon arrival times to achieve high depth accuracy from sparse views and low photon flux.

items.title: A Control-Theoretic Approximation to Predictive Coding Dynamics
items.description: Backpropagation remains the dominant method for training deep neural networks, but its reliance on non-local computations has motivated the search for biologically plausible alternatives.
items.ai_summary: Deep feedback control serves as a control-theoretic local approximation to predictive coding dynamics near fixed points, offering a biologically plausible alternative for training neural networks.

items.title: ResVision: Spectrum-Matched Resizing and Context-Preserving Inspection for Visual Reasoning
items.description: Agentic visual reasoning improves vision-language models by selectively enlarging evidence without adding new scene content, but the benefit depends on whether fine structure remains accessible and whether local observations stay grounded in the full scene.
items.ai_summary: ResVision combines spectrum-matched resizing and context-preserving inspection to improve visual reasoning in vision-language models by dynamically allocating visual tokens and retaining global context alongside local crops.

items.title: Language-Oriented Semantic Modeling for Target Language Extraction
items.description: Target Language Extraction (TLE) aims to isolate speech in a target language from multilingual mixtures. Existing approaches primarily rely on acoustic modeling with language identity labels, which provide only coarse categorical guidance.
items.ai_summary: Language-oriented semantic modeling framework integrates language-aware semantic representations derived from a pre-trained speech model into acoustic extraction to improve target language isolation from multilingual speech mixtures.

items.title: C-LiTE: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Cellular feature learning in Histopathology
items.description: Characterising individual cells is fundamental to computational pathology, as cellular morphology informs tasks such as tumour grading, mitotic assessment and immune profiling.
items.ai_summary: C-LiTE is a lightweight 22-million parameter foundation model utilizing native-resolution tokenisation to learn cellular representations from histopathology image crops for tasks like tumour grading and immune profiling.

items.title: Actor-Predictor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning with Formal Specification Objectives
items.description: One fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is enforcing temporal safety constraints, such as satisfying formal specifications. Existing methods often transform logic formulas into automata for state augmentation and reward shaping.
items.ai_summary: Actor-Predictor is a reinforcement learning framework that uses a learned surrogate representation to satisfy formal specification objectives without constructing an automaton, outperforming baselines on robotic tasks.

items.title: Client Exits - A Way to Increase LLM Transparency on the Client Side
items.description: Textual recommendations generated by large language models (LLMs) can be difficult to inspect. This paper introduces \emph{Client Exits}, a lightweight mechanism for enriching LLM responses while separating semantic intent from client-specific presentation.
items.ai_summary: Client Exits is a lightweight mechanism that allows large language models to insert machine-interpretable markers into outputs, enabling clients to customize how supplementary information is presented.

items.title: Scalable fault vulnerability analysis for ReRAM-based process-in-memory CNN accelerators
items.description: Resistive random-access memory (ReRAM)-based processing-in-memory (PIM) accelerators offer a highly efficient platform for parallel matrix-vector multiplications (VMM) in neural networks, leveraging analog computation, high density, low leakage, and non-volatility.
items.ai_summary: A scalable analytical framework quantifies permanent fault vulnerabilities in convolutional neural networks deployed on resistive random-access memory PIM accelerators without requiring exhaustive simulations.

items.title: A Tensor-Algebraic No-Go Theorem for High-Dimensional Photonic Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger States Discovered with AlphaProof Nexus
items.description: Photonic GHZ states generated with probabilistic pair sources can be described by edge-coloured, complex-weighted graphs.
items.ai_summary: AlphaProof Nexus assisted in discovering a tensor-algebraic no-go theorem proving that no complex-weighted monochromatic quantum graph exists for even photon numbers and high dimensions.

items.title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
items.description: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization.
items.ai_summary: Skill.png optimizes image-space agent skills via gradient descent through a frozen vision-language model encoder, improving performance and transferability while using fewer tokens than textual skills.

items.title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
items.description: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads.
items.ai_summary: BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder model that predicts vehicle speed, path, collision risk, and candidate futures from a single camera in real time.

items.title: Who Moved My $Z$ Boson? Revealing Resonance Features Inside a Neural Network
items.description: Methods used in mechanistic interpretability have revealed human-aligned concepts inside language and image models. In this paper, we search for physics concepts inside a neural a generative collider physics model trained on real LHC data (ShellFlow).
items.ai_summary: Mechanistic interpretability methods reveal that a generative collider physics model trained on unlabeled data contains internal features representing specific particle resonances that can be modified.

items.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
items.description: Critique overlap among peer reviews is rising, and reviews identified as LLM-generated are less distinct from each other, indicating decreasing diversity of critiques.
items.ai_summary: An analysis of peer review data shows that review critique overlap has risen across major conferences and journals, with LLM-flagged reviews displaying higher homogenization than unflagged ones.

items.title: What If Chain-of-Thought Is Not Enough?
items.description: Reasoning capabilities in large language models have evolved from prompting-based methods to internalized model behaviors. In this paper, we investigate whether the internal thinking model of an LLM can be deliberately changed and whether such a change is beneficial.
items.ai_summary: Training language models to use a structured decision process called Question-Option-Criteria instead of standard Chain-of-Thought improves answer quality and internal consistency.

items.title: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
items.description: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support parallel generation, yet they often require many denoising steps because only a fraction of token predictions are sufficiently reliable to be committed at each step.
items.ai_summary: dLoop restructures pretrained diffusion language models into a looped architecture that recurrently refines latent representations before token commitment, improving accuracy across reasoning benchmarks.

items.title: Tracking Objects Through Assembly and Decomposition
items.description: Tracking objects through transformations is essential for understanding real-world dynamics. Recent work has extended traditional object tracking to detect state changes.
items.ai_summary: Atlas is a zero-shot video tracking system that jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and detect both decomposition and assembly events.

items.title: A Statistical Framework for Training Data Auditing of Large Language Models
items.description: Training-data auditing asks whether data of interest were used to train a large language model (LLM), a question central to privacy auditing, copyright protection, and benchmark-contamination detection.
items.ai_summary: This paper proposes a unified statistical framework for document-level membership inference, target-collection global auditing, and suspicious-subset identification in large language models.

items.title: Digitization of Analogue Gauges using Computer Vision
items.description: Analogue gauges remain prevalent in manufacturing industries for measuring physical quantities, yet manual monitoring by operators introduces human error and operational inefficiency.
items.ai_summary: This research develops and evaluates an automated analogue gauge reading system using computer vision and deep learning, finding that the ResNet18 architecture achieves an accuracy of 97.3%.

items.title: Similarity-based OSF Logic for Flexible SPARQL Query Answering
items.description: We present an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature (OSF) logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs.
items.ai_summary: This paper introduces an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs.

items.title: SkillBridge: Cost-Aware Diagnosis and Repair of Cross-OS Compatibility Defects in Agent Skills
items.description: LLM agents increasingly reuse executable capabilities through skills, but a skill that works on one OS may fail on another because OS assumptions are spread across guide text, scripts, metadata, install contracts, and local entrypoints.
items.ai_summary: SkillBridge is a contract-based workflow that uses static analysis, dynamic validation, and repair to cost-effectively diagnose and fix cross-OS compatibility defects in agent skills.

items.title: STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery
items.description: Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale.
items.ai_summary: STAGE is a framework that combines weak-supervision construction with spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences to discover causal relations across independent social media posts.

items.title: Prism: Hierarchical Text Detection with Minimalist Design
items.description: Hierarchical text detection aims to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs while parsing their structural relationships. It provides essential structural cues for visual text understanding.
items.ai_summary: Prism is a minimalist framework for hierarchical text detection that uses a single-scale backbone and parallel lightweight heads to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs with high efficiency.

items.title: The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) aims to enable agents to adapt to changing tasks while preserving previously acquired capabilities. Evaluation often relies on final aggregate metrics that can hide temporary performance degradation during adaptation.
items.ai_summary: This paper introduces a continual reinforcement learning benchmark and demonstrates the stability gap, which is a temporary drop in prior-task performance after new tasks are introduced.

items.title: Beyond Covers and Titles: Evidence-First Ranking for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
items.description: Short-video platforms rank new uploads before anyone has watched them, using content towers that read a video's cover, title and frames.
items.ai_summary: Evidence-First Ranking is a ranking method that scores cold videos from their body and uses a bounded support-gated residual to defend against packaging edits on short-video platforms.

items.title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
items.description: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments.
items.ai_summary: TwinLab-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI scientists on self-designed experiments across 52 tasks from physical science, life science, and engineering laboratories.

items.title: FastRoverVLA: Fast Vision-Language-Action Execution for Off-Road Autonomous Driving
items.description: Off-road vision-language-action (VLA) models generate scene-conditioned plans, but frequent trajectory updates can repeatedly invoke expensive multimodal inference. Reusing a prediction reduces this demand while leaving its commands exposed to changes in vehicle motion.
items.ai_summary: FastRoverVLA is a training-free interface for off-road vision-language-action models that decouples visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution to reduce inference costs and trajectory errors.

items.title: Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
items.description: Developing generalizable, data-efficient machine learning (ML) models for advanced manufacturing remains challenging because experimental datasets are limited and process-property relationships vary across materials and operating conditions.
items.ai_summary: Physics-informed dimensionless features combined with pretrained tabular foundation models improve generalizable melt pool width, depth, and melting mode predictions in advanced manufacturing.

items.title: Attention Drift Regularization with Adaptive Initialization for Domain-Robust Visual Recognition
items.description: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a pretrained source model to unlabeled target domains without source data access, yet two critical failure modes remain unaddressed.
items.ai_summary: DGA-CAFC is a domain-robust visual recognition method that uses counterfactual attention consistency and domain-gap-aware source model selection to prevent attention drift and stabilize pseudo-label quality.

items.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
items.description: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality.
items.ai_summary: Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery is a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity.

items.title: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
items.description: Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior.
items.ai_summary: Phase transitions in sample complexity explain how attention heads specialize during training as a function of available dataset size.

items.title: Sightline: Calibrated Data-Flow Summaries for LLM-Integrated Applications
items.description: Programs increasingly call large language models (LLMs), filling prompt placeholders with program values and consuming the output. Such a call crosses the boundary between natural language and programming language (NL/PL).
items.ai_summary: Sightline is a calibrated data-flow summarization tool for LLM-integrated applications that tracks prompt placeholders to model outputs using attention patterns and log-probability gradients.

items.title: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
items.description: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors.
items.ai_summary: MixReact is a physics-based reactive humanoid control framework that uses a mixture of transformers to generate physical behaviors from text, audio, and video cues.

items.title: Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author
items.description: Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer "who wrote this?" at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human,…
items.ai_summary: Frontier large language models can identify whether a single text was written by a human or an AI and frequently name the specific human author or AI lab.

items.title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
items.description: SpecWM is a training-free inference framework for streaming video world models that verifies draft chunks using the target model's latent velocity field and applies reusable corrections via threshold-based accept/refine/reject decisions to improve visual quality, control, and…
items.ai_summary: SpecWM is a training-free inference framework for streaming world models that uses latent velocity fields to verify and refine draft video chunks for improved efficiency and quality.

items.title: Learn, Freeze, and Transfer an Activation Function Across Architectures
items.description: Transfer learning typically reuses knowledge acquired by a source network through its learned weights. We investigate whether a learned activation function can also be transferred and remain useful in networks trained from scratch.
items.ai_summary: A learn-freeze-transfer protocol optimizes a pointwise activation function in a source network and reuses it in target networks with different architectures trained from scratch.

items.title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
items.description: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning.
items.ai_summary: A data selection and synthesis method adapts training data for vision-language models to improve reasoning faithfulness and accuracy when using image-zooming tools.

items.title: A version of the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for full/quad pol synthetic aperture radar data
items.description: Based on the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition of reflection symmetric polarimetric SAR data we present a version for full/quad polarisation data. We demonstrate both versions on X-band F-SAR data over Vejers, Denmark.
items.ai_summary: A version of the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for full or quad-polarisation synthetic aperture radar data improves the focus on dominant scattering mechanisms for bright man-made targets.

items.title: Backbone Matters: Benchmarking Encoder-Decoder Networks for Semantic Segmentation of Driving Scenes on BDD100K
items.description: Semantic segmentation gives an autonomous vehicle a dense, pixel-level description of its surroundings and is a core part of scene understanding.
items.ai_summary: A systematic benchmark of 52 encoder-decoder network combinations on the BDD100K driving dataset reveals that an FPN decoder combined with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone achieves the highest segmentation accuracy.

items.title: Invertible Transport Between Sample-Only Distributions via Projected Characteristic Functions
items.description: Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models.
items.ai_summary: Projected Characteristic-Function matching is a density-free framework that learns an invertible map between sample-only distributions and empirical priors without requiring density estimation or adversarial training.

items.title: Reward misalignment as an opportunity for materials discovery
items.description: Reward misalignment is usually regarded as a failure of artificial intelligence. In materials discovery with generative AI models, however, disagreement between predefined rewards and expert judgment may reveal materials that the rewards overlook.
items.ai_summary: A materials discovery framework uses expert preferences learned from pairwise comparisons to guide a generative crystal model and identify overlooked compounds through reward misalignment.

items.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Neural Networks for a Universal Fluid Gibbs Free Energy Equation of State
items.description: Over the past three centuries, many thermodynamics researchers have worked to develop fluid equations of state with both high accuracy and broad applicability, proposing various theoretical frameworks and models.
items.ai_summary: A machine learning framework called GEoS uses thermodynamically consistent neural networks to construct a universal fluid equation of state based on Gibbs free energy with high density accuracy.

items.title: RegionAgent: Two-Stage Preference Optimization for Regional Image Restoration
items.description: Images under non-uniform coupled degradations require diverse restoration capabilities for different degraded regions.
items.ai_summary: RegionAgent is an adaptive restoration framework that trains a vision-language model using two-stage preference optimization to generate region-specific restoration actions for non-uniformly degraded images.

items.title: FlexVSR: Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution for Streaming Video Generation
items.description: Real-time streaming video generation has gained rapid momentum in live content creation and interactive media. Deploying such systems in practice requires flexible scaling factors to accommodate diverse source resolutions, target displays, and computational budgets.
items.ai_summary: FlexVSR is a decoupled framework for continuous-scale streaming generative video super-resolution that uses a lightweight latent adapter to generalize a frozen prior across scales without retraining the diffusion transformer.

items.title: SpatialScout-V2: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore Real-World 3D Scenes and Localize Objects?
items.description: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations.
items.ai_summary: SpatialScout-V2 introduces a real-world benchmark for evaluating vision-language model agents on active 3D scene exploration and object center localization.

items.title: Budget Internalization: Fixed-Budget RLVR Trades Test-Time Scaling for In-Budget Accuracy
items.description: Reasoning models often become more accurate when they can generate longer answers at test time. This behavior is known as test-time scaling. However, RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually trains them with a fixed rollout cap.
items.ai_summary: Fixed-budget reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards causes reasoning models to internalize training rollout caps as length constraints that limit their test-time scaling performance.

items.title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
items.description: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale.
items.ai_summary: The FrontierOR Challenge introduces a benchmark and competition for building agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for complex operations research optimization problems.

items.title: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
items.description: AFFECT, an auxiliary objective that trains world models to match visual responses to temporally correlated action noise, improves rollout fidelity and planning success in simulated and real robotic tasks.

items.title: DailySafe: Benchmarking Dynamic Safety Awareness in Everyday Multi-Turn Multimodal Interactions
items.description: A new benchmark, DailySafe, evaluates the ability of multimodal large language models to maintain safety and address evolving risks within complex, multi-turn, real-world interactions.

items.title: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
items.description: VETO suppresses shortcut learning in VideoLLMs by projecting supervised fine-tuning updates onto the orthogonal complement of the text-only activation subspace, improving out-of-distribution video reasoning.

items.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
items.description: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same?

items.description: A large-scale benchmark of 94 curated biomedical tabular datasets standardizes evaluation across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks and finds that foundation models lead overall while tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain competitive under…

items.title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
items.description: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues.

items.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
items.description: StrideWorld is a benchmark that fixes references before motion to detect scene deformation and action inconsistency in interactive video world models, showing that most models deform scenes and only depth-scaled command models preserve composed routes.

items.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
items.description: AnyS1 converts procedural skills into shared decision points, trains a small calibrated pointer model to resolve routine choices, and falls back to a large model when uncertain, reducing cost and latency while preserving reliability.

items.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
items.description: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics.

items.title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents.

items.title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
items.description: BiCAT shares a motion representation across arms and conditions each arm's tokens on its partner via symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder, enabling parallel arm token prediction and improving bimanual manipulation success.

items.title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
items.description: Chorus shares one set of n-gram embedding tables across all layers, letting each layer project and rescale the embedding using its hidden state, achieving better quality with much smaller tables and lower optimizer memory.

items.title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
items.description: FVSCORE is a neuro-symbolic evaluation framework that compiles videos into prompt and implicit constraint propositions, verifies them with perceptual tools and soft temporal logic, and calibrates significant violations to produce interpretable, human-aligned feedback for video…

items.title: donovancraig54/ai-code-executor
items.description: Run AI code instantly > sandboxed, automated, effortless with Auto-Fix!
items.ai_summary: Open-source code executor that runs AI code inside isolated Docker containers with pre-installed tools and Auto-Fix capabilities.

items.title: Choosing Quantized Code LLMs by File Size and Energy per Solved Task
items.description: A developer running a code assistant on a laptop downloads one model file, and local inference moves the energy of every request onto that machine. A common rule says a larger model at lower precision tends to beat a smaller one at higher precision.

items.title: lynote-ai/local-ai-note-taker
items.description: Local AI note taker for meetings. Records calls with no bot, transcribes on your computer with Whisper, and writes AI meeting notes and minutes. Built for long meetings in Chinese; 9 spoken languages. Recordings never leave your computer. Free for Windows and Linux.
items.ai_summary: Open-source meeting assistant that records calls without a bot, transcribes audio locally using Whisper, and generates meeting notes and summaries on your computer.

items.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
items.description: LightTAR adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task by adding target-aware features from encoder layers via regularized partial least squares, improving multimodal tabular model performance with minimal runtime overhead.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Turbo Lora UNCENSORED Workflow
items.description: Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack
items.ai_summary: Tool that generates videos with a synchronized soundtrack.

items.title: P-Image-OSS

items.description: Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history.

items.title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
items.description: A prototype-guided progressive obfuscation method preserves relative item relations while perturbing high-influence semantic embeddings to defend against inversion attacks in LLM-enhanced recommender systems.
